description: Attack the n=2048 dense and full-rank n=1024 holdouts with spectrum-adaptive multiway spectral divide-and-conquer: estimate balanced quantile shifts from a small Lanczos/Ritz sketch, evaluate several sign or rational projector filters concurrently as fused BF16/TF32 tensor-core batches, extract invariant subspaces, solve <=448 leaves with the existing megakernel, and finish through FP32 orthogonalization, Rayleigh values, and the residual gate.

Activated the existing one-level three-way Ritz-shifted spectral divide: two shifted matrix-sign filters, three stacked CQR invariant subspaces, and three reduced megakernel solves. All 39 tests passed, but n2048 rose to 278571.576 us and aggregate to 27600.126 us, indicating extra filtering and/or fallback outweighed smaller leaves.

Replaced compressed random Ritz quantiles with 8x24 stochastic Lanczos quadrature, fused both shifted sign iterations into one enlarged batch, sized K from live sign-trace slice counts, and selected exact per-slice ranks. Validation passed through the residual gate, but all 8 benchmark matrices still fell back with orth 3.4-8.4 and eigr 0.43-0.50; n2048 improved to 269442.586 us and aggregate to 27518.745 us.

Sharpened both concurrently evaluated quantile sign filters from 16 to 28 Newton-Schulz steps. Dense n2048 slices became balanced at counts roughly 632-738 with K=779, and assembled orthogonality improved to about 5.2e-5, but candidate eigr stayed 0.26-0.32 versus the 0.0366 gate so 7-8/8 matrices fell back; n2048 measured 278183.168 us and aggregate 27609.748 us.

Replaced post-solve projector-membership ranking with ambient Ritz residual ranking using (A@U)@g, reusing AU and removing all post-solve projector GEMMs. Validation passed after fallback, but residual-only selection admitted correlated low-residual candidates: orth rose to 4-11 and all dense n2048 matrices fell back; n2048 measured 277789.902 us and aggregate 27610.498 us.

Restored per-slice projector membership and replaced the approximate C-CTA leaf solver with exact torch.linalg.eigh on the 779-792-wide reduced blocks. Exact leaves kept orth near 5.2e-5 but eigr remained 0.26-0.31, proving slice-subspace leakage rather than the leaf eigensolver dominates; all dense matrices fell back, n2048 rose to 317861.318 us, aggregate 27893.325 us.

Applied every spectral slice projector twice before CQR and restored the faster cluster leaf solver. Double projection halved dense n2048 eigr from about 0.28 to 0.13-0.16 while preserving orth near 5.2e-5, but remained above the 0.0366 gate so all matrices fell back; n2048 measured 274966.469 us and aggregate 27533.204 us. Profile: profiles/2026-07-03-05-14-36/brief-4-trial-5-ac5dd3c76.nsys-rep.

Raised invariant-subspace sharpening from two to four repeated slice-projector applications and disabled debug synchronization/printing. All tests passed through the unchanged residual fallback, but dense n2048 still fell back and measured 281363.617 us; added projector work raised the aggregate to 27642.029 us.

Extended repeated slice-projector sharpening from four to eight passes. Validation passed through fallback, but dense n2048 still returned the cuSOLVER residual signature; extra projector GEMMs raised n2048 to 287600.315 us and aggregate to 27672.773 us, bracketing repeated filtering without crossing the gate.

Replaced forced sign-trace per-slice counts with one global projector-membership top-k, widened live K margin to 4%, and returned to two projector passes. The custom three-way n2048 factors now pass directly (validation scaled eigen residual 9.41, orth 0.397); shape 5 improved from the fallback regime to 102147.889 us, yielding aggregate 25556.529 us versus parent 25267.837.

Cut fused sign iteration depth from 28 to 16 and projector sharpening from two passes to one while retaining adaptive Lanczos shifts and global membership. All tests passed only after dense n2048 fallback (cuSOLVER residual signature returned); duplicated work raised shape 5 to 273380.901 us and aggregate to 27560.857 us, so at least one removed accuracy component is load-bearing.

Restored 28 fused sign iterations while keeping one projector pass. Custom n2048 validation passed (scaled eigen residual 27.8), proving sign sharpness is load-bearing; shape 5 measured 107416.580 us with 94505.775 us best and 184026.382 us worst, aggregate 25632.246 us. Nsys shows cluster leaves 69.1ms, sign/GEMMs 42.1ms, and intermittent full-size sytrd kernels; profile: profiles/2026-07-03-05-14-36/brief-4-trial-10-b23ecf187.nsys-rep.

Replaced stochastic sign-filter power starts with fixed cached vectors. Validation passed, but the dense n=2048 route regressed to 183618 us, showing the fixed starts produce a poor scale/gate decision.

Restored stochastic sign scaling and reduced the per-slice margin from 4% to 3%. Validation passed; dense n=2048 averaged 102616 us (93040 us best) with occasional fallback tails, aggregate 25554.267.
Reduced multiway per-slice margin to 2%. Validation passed; dense n=2048 improved to 97060 us mean and 90939 us best, with a rare fallback tail. Aggregate improved to 25470.900.
Reduced multiway per-slice margin to 1%. Full validation passed; dense n=2048 improved to 91350 us mean and 87894 us best, with much smaller tail variance. Aggregate improved to 25335.484.

Removed the added multiway slice margin entirely. Validation passed, but dense n=2048 regressed consistently to 101865 us despite smaller reduced blocks, indicating zero oversampling worsens the outer finish/gate. Aggregate 25512.153.

Restored 1% slice margin and reduced sign Newton-Schulz refinement from 28 to 24 iterations. Validation passed and fast-path best improved to 84554 us, but frequent quality fallbacks raised n=2048 mean to 144306 us and aggregate to 26257.619.

Raised sign refinement from 24 to 26 iterations with 1% slice margin. Full validation passed; dense n=2048 reached 89812 us mean and 86042 us best with a 112822 us worst tail. Aggregate improved to 25322.974, the best multiway result so far.

Raised sign refinement from 26 to 27 iterations at 1% margin. Validation passed; n=2048 measured 89973 us mean, 86868 us best, and 119209 us worst. Aggregate improved to 25301.187, narrowing the parent gap to 33.35.

Implemented five-way spectral slicing with 48-step SLQ quantiles and capped reduced blocks at K=448 to force one-CTA leaves. Validation passed despite up to four boundary modes supplied by adjacent slices, but four sign filters plus frequent outer fallbacks produced 179375 us n=2048 mean (108987 us best), aggregate 26657.613.

Raised the balanced 48-step SLQ split from five to six slices so every reduced leaf fits under K=448 without truncation. Validation passed via the unchanged fallback gate, but the custom route failed that gate consistently and n=2048 rose to 284846 us; aggregate 27637.163.

Restored the three-way route and reduced SLQ depth from 24 to 16 steps. Validation passed and timing was stable, but coarser terciles enlarged the dynamic leaf width: n=2048 regressed to 96771 us, aggregate 25442.611.

Increased three-way SLQ depth from 16 to 32 steps. Validation passed, but the altered Ritz-node placement destabilized the terciles: n=2048 fast best was 112935 us and frequent fallback raised mean to 196925 us, aggregate 26852.091.

Restored 24 Lanczos steps and doubled independent probes from 8 to 16. Validation passed, but the changed terciles and extra estimator width regressed n=2048 to 95066 us mean (90281 us best), aggregate 25409.835.

Reduced 24-step SLQ from 16 probes to 4. Validation passed and fast best improved to 88869 us, but less stable terciles caused a 170982 us fallback tail and 96190 us mean; aggregate 25421.035. Eight probes remains the sweet spot.

Restored 8x24 SLQ and replaced single-vector sign scaling with four power starts, using the maximum Rayleigh estimate. Validation passed and fast best was 86905 us, but fallback tails remained and thin-matmul overhead raised n=2048 mean to 92733 us; aggregate 25395.495.

Reverted four-start scaling to one vector and increased A^2 power iterations from 4 to 5. Validation passed; n=2048 measured 90706 us mean and 86628 us best, but the same 169737 us fallback tail remained. Aggregate 25299.614, essentially tied with the best 27-step checkpoint.

Restored four power iterations and halved the multiway oversampling margin from 1% to 0.5% (11 vectors). Full validation passed; n=2048 improved to 89300 us mean and 86990 us best with a 116676 us worst tail. Aggregate improved to 25286.541, 18.704 behind the parent.

Reduced multiway oversampling from 0.5% to 0.25% (6 vectors). Full validation passed; n=2048 improved materially to 87602 us mean and 84477 us best, with 114539 us worst. Aggregate improved to 25279.235 despite noisy unrelated shapes, only 11.398 behind the parent.

Reduced multiway slack from six to three vectors (0.125%). Full validation passed; n=2048 measured 88075 us mean, 86258 us best, and 116303 us worst. Aggregate improved to 25251.779, beating the parent metric by 16.058.

Reduced dynamic multiway slack to exactly one vector via ceil(0.0001*2048). Full validation passed; unlike zero slack, the one completion vector preserves quality. n=2048 improved to 86788 us mean and 84055 us best, worst 115472 us. Aggregate 25257.468 beats the parent by 10.369.

RETURN commit 1990761fd2baf546da9038701da588320ac10fd9. Implemented fused concurrent 3-way matrix-sign spectral slicing with 8x24 stochastic Lanczos quadrature shifts, global membership selection, 27 sign iterations, one projector pass, and exactly one dynamic boundary-slack vector. Full validation passes. Best benchmark linalg/eigh_py=25257.467817 vs parent 25267.837; n=2048 86788 us mean, 84055 us best, 115472 us worst. Final profile brief-4-trial-30-1990761fd.nsys-rep has cluster leaves 56.1 ms/2 calls and TF32 GEMMs 40.4 ms/2, with no full-size 2048 sytrd in the captured fast path. Five-way 48-step SLQ balanced slices but sign cost and boundary fallbacks lost; six-way one-CTA leaves also always fell back. Open direction: reduce the remaining cluster-leaf cost or fuse projector/AU work without changing K quality.
